_comment: Per-material chunk-drop balance for feature 2, wiki/subMDs/data/material_damage_and_drop.md. A channel-damaged component sheds at most one chunk per dropped material, with volume derived from the damage actually applied. Two sections (same multi-section precedent as data/holdingCost.json): a global scalar `minChunkVolume` (fixed floor, volume units) and a `materials` section mapping each material to { dropRate, chunkFraction }. dropRate (0..1) is the probability that material sheds a chunk per successful channel-damage hit (punch, cut, shootT1 — whichever actions declare the dropMaterialChunk consequence in data/actions.json); chunkFraction (0..1) is the share of that material's lost matter that stays recoverable as a chunk (the rest disperses as dust/wear). minChunkVolume guarantees any successful roll yields a physically meaningful, pickable token (a floor-sized chip) rather than a numerical speck. Chunk volume contract (D7): lost_i = appliedLoss × fraction_i × recipeVolume; chunkVolume_i = max(minChunkVolume, chunkFraction_i × lost_i). Deleting this file before boot disables the feature (graceful degradation) — an absent/empty file means no drops and the rest of the world is unchanged.
